name: What factors influence the cost of framing a new window opening?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of framing a new window opening?

acceptedAnswer.text: Window opening framing costs depend on structural factors rather than a single flat rate. Major cost drivers include whether the target wall is load-bearing or non-load-bearing, wall thickness (such as 2x4 versus 2x6 framing), exterior siding material (brick and stone require masonry cutting, whereas vinyl or wood lap siding is easier to open), and the span width of the opening. Additional factors include whether electrical wiring or plumbing pipes inside the wall cavity need relocation by licensed trades, and the subsequent drywall finishing and trim carpentry required around the new rough opening.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on whether the wall is load-bearing, opening width, exterior siding type, hidden electrical or plumbing relocations, and required interior drywall or trim work.
